top_signals.title: Citi FX Traders Back Carry But Warn Against ‘Set and Forget’
top_signals.summary: Citigroup Inc.’s US currency desk expects the carry trade to keep offering opportunities for investors even though the strategy may struggle to replicate a period of standout returns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hedge Funds Back SEC Push to Ease Rules on EU Bond Futures
top_signals.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission should add the European Union to a four-decade old list of exempted issuers, a move that would ease restrictions on US investor access to the bloc’s new bond futures market, according to a group representing hedge funds.
